pull_request.title: TS-817: Self-change loop from chat request to verified Updated, with undo and changelog
pull_request.body:
Part of TS-817 (slice 2: the self-change loop). Closes nothing yet; the live proof on the deployed cluster follows once B (chat), G (e2e) and I (rollout) are on main.

## What
- `cos self change '<json>'` (called by the COS agent; `behavior/brief.md` tells it when a request is a ts-cos self-change): queues the user's words, a one-line summary, `debug` (Opus 5.5 high vs Haiku 5.5) and an acceptance check.
- Leader-only driver (`selfchange.go`, a `serveWorkers` entry under `Bus.Lead`). Records live in the R3 KV bucket `COS_SELF` with CAS updates, so a failover resumes where it stopped. Steps: Ku ticket under TS-769 → branch `cos/<ticket>-self` whose first commit is `checks/<ticket>.json` → the check must fail on every live node → worker thread on the least busy host with a brief from `behavior/templates/selfbrief.tmpl` → PR linked and watched → gate → squash merge with an `Update-Note:` trailer (TS-818 toast contract) → rollout → check on every node → `Updated: <summary> (<sha>)` in chat, Ku comment + Done, worker thread closed.
- Acceptance checks (`checks/`, `selfcheck.go`): declarative so COS writes them before any code exists. Either a dashboard path, fetched by every node from its own dashboard and signed in as `cos-probe` like `Auth.ProbeSession`, or a behavior template, rendered on every node. Each check has contains/absent strings. `TestRepoAcceptanceChecks` runs every committed check against the PR build in CI. After rollout the leader asks every node over `cos.<host>.selfcheck`.
- Gate (`selfchange_forgejo.go`): every CI context green; ts-reviewer must finish, and only findings matching security/data-loss terms hold the merge (the worker gets woken by the bot comment and fixes them); mergeable.
- Guardrails in code: a PR touching login, deploy/rollback, `.forgejo/`, e2e, vault/leader/bus, go.mod, the self-change code, another check, or editing its own check is refused ("needs you" line). One rollout at a time: a green PR waits while another self-change is merged but not yet verified.
- Undo: `cos self undo [ticket]` builds a revert PR through the Forgejo contents API (every file of the squash commit back to its parent version; refuses if main changed one of those files since). It takes the same gate and rollout, then is verified when the original check fails on every node, and posts `Reverted: ...`.
- Changelog: `cos self log [all]` lists today's (or every) change with request, ticket, PR, sha and verified time, plus a `text` rendered from `behavior/templates/changes.tmpl` for "what changed today?".
- Chat progress: one short line per state change, rendered from `progress.tmpl`.

## Minimal versions of other streams' pieces (`selfchange_stubs.go`)
- B (TS-811) chat: `selfChatPost` writes a `role: cos` entry in B's `COS_CHAT` JSON shape and key format; it only logs while the bucket is absent. Switch to `Chat.Put` when B merges.
- I (TS-818) rollout: waits for `cos.events.deploy.deploy.completed` with `data.to` == merge sha (or a later main commit that contains it) and fails on `deploy.rolled_back` (`data.reason`), read from `COS_EVENTS`. Behavior-only PRs skip the deploy: live once every reporting node loads the bundle published after the merge (from #10).
- G (TS-816) e2e: the gate requires every CI status context to be green, so G's e2e status context blocks merges as soon as it reports on PRs. No e2e-specific code here.

## Size
1,849 lines, of which 473 are tests and 56 docs/behavior text. It stays one PR because the state machine only reads (and tests) correctly as a whole.

## Checks run
- `templ generate`, build, vet and `go test ./...` green; zero-config guard: "no new switches".
- `TestSelfChangeLoopAndUndo` (3 embedded nodes + fake Forgejo): ticket → check committed first → worker → CI pending holds → security finding holds → LOW finding does not → merge body `Update-Note: …` at the checked head → waits for rollout → waits while the live check fails → `Updated: Header reads Fleet (merge70)`. Then undo → revert PR → merge → verified only once the check fails again → `Reverted: …`, original marked reverted, a second undo refused, changelog text shows the revert.
- `TestSelfChangeGuardsAndQueue`: check already passing → blocked; PR touching `dashboard_auth.go` → blocked before merge with a "needs you" line; second green PR queued behind a rolling one; PR that edits its own check → blocked.
- `TestSelfCheckOnEveryNode`: 3 nodes answer over NATS; a failing check reports evidence from each; a node rejects an invalid (`http://evil/`) check.
- Not run live: needs B/I merged and this build deployed. Assumption to confirm then: T3's worktree launch with `baseRef` == `branch` == an existing origin branch and `startFromOrigin: true` checks out that branch.
